cards.ex: I momentarily forgot where I parked the car; it was quite embarrassing.
cards.exUz: Men mashinani qayerga qo'yganimni bir zumda unutib qo'ydim; bu juda uyatli edi.
cards.uzDef: Bir zumga nimani eslash kerakligini unutib qo'ymoq, qisqa muddatga xotiradan o'chib ketmoq.

cards.ex: The upcoming exam is really preying on my mind; I can't seem to relax.
cards.exUz: Bo'lajak imtihon meni juda tashvishga solmoqda; men dam ololmayapman.
cards.uzDef: Nimanidir doimiy ravishda o'ylamoq, bu narsa tinchlik bermayotganini anglatadi.

cards.ex: A lapse in concentration caused him to make a critical error during the presentation.
cards.exUz: Diqqatning susayishi uning taqdimot davomida jiddiy xatoga yo'l qo'yishiga sabab bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni jamlash qobiliyatining qisqa muddatga yo'qolishi.

cards.ex: I felt like I was losing my grip during the crisis, but I managed to pull through.
cards.exUz: Men inqiroz paytida o'zimni nazoratni yo'qotayotgandek his qildim, lekin uddaladim.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yoki o'zingizni nazorat qilishni to'xtatmoq.

cards.ex: The loud music completely drowned out our conversation.
cards.exUz: Balant musiqa suhbatimizni butunlay bosib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Tovush yoki boshqa ta'sirni shu qadar kuchli bo'lishi tufayli eshitilmaydigan yoki sezilmaydigan holga keltirmoq.

cards.ex: I meant to call you, but it completely slipped my mind.
cards.exUz: Senga qo'ng'iroq qilmoqchi edim, lekin butunlay esimdan chiqib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani unutib qo'ymoq.

cards.ex: Constant interruptions will definitely derail the creative process.
cards.exUz: Doimiy aralashuvlar ijodiy jarayonni buzishi aniq.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirilgan jarayonni to'xtatmoq yoki yo'nalishdan chiqarmoq.

cards.ex: She's completely fixated on getting into that university.
cards.exUz: U butunlay shu universitetga kirishga bog'langan.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni faqat bir narsaga qaratmoq, shu narsa haqida doimiy o'ylamoq.

cards.ex: The concert was so amazing, it felt like a waking dream.
cards.exUz: Konsert juda ajoyib edi, xuddi tushdek tuyuldi.
cards.uzDef: Real hayotda bo'layotgan, lekin tushga o'xshash xayoliy tasavvur.

cards.ex: Looking out at the audience, I saw a sea of faces.
cards.exUz: Tomoshabinlarga qarab, men odamlar olomonini ko'rdim.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p sonli odamlar, odamlar yuzlarining ko'pligi.

cards.ex: Sometimes I get lost in thought while commuting to work.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan ishga qatnayotganda xayolga cho'mib ketaman.
cards.uzDef: O'ylash bilan band bo'lib, atrofingizdagi narsalarni sezmay qolmoq.

cards.ex: I can easily lose myself in a good book for hours.
cards.exUz: Men yaxshi kitobga soatlab berilib ketishim mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Nimadidirga butunlay berilib ketmoq, o'zingizni unutmoq.

cards.ex: Mental health is at the forefront of the discussion now.
cards.exUz: Ruhiy salomatlik hozir muhokama markazida.
cards.uzDef: Diqqat markazida, eng muhim yoki mashhur o'rinda bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: He went off on a tangent about his vacation plans.
cards.exUz: U o'zining ta'til rejalari haqida mavzudan chetga chiqib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy mavzudan chetga chiqib, boshqa narsalar haqida gapira boshlamoq.

cards.ex: I said things I didn't mean in the heat of the moment.
cards.exUz: Men hayajon paytida aytmoqchi bo'lmagan narsalarni aytdim.
cards.term: in the heat of the moment
cards.uzDef: Kuchli his-tuyg'ular hukmron bo'lgan paytda.

cards.ex: The bright colors really draw your attention to the painting.
cards.exUz: Yorqin ranglar haqiqatan ham diqqatingizni suratga tortadi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatingizni nimagadir jalb qilmoq.

cards.ex: The report had a glaring omission – it didn't mention the budget.
cards.exUz: Hisobotda ko'zga tashlanadigan xato bor edi - unda byudjet haqida aytilmagan.
cards.uzDef: Osonlikcha ko'rish mumkin bo'lgan, muhim narsaning tashlab ketilishi.

cards.ex: Don't take your eye off the negotiations; things can change quickly.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralarni ko'zdan qochirmang; vaziyat tez o'zgarishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani kuzatishni yoki nazorat qilishni to'xtatmoq.

cards.ex: Some important details slipped through the cracks during the project.
cards.exUz: Loyihada ba'zi muhim tafsilotlar e'tibordan chetda qoldi.
cards.uzDef: E'tibordan chetda qolib, sezilmay qolmoq, muammoni hal qilmasdan o'tkazib yubormoq.

cards.ex: She always tries to hog the limelight at every meeting.
cards.exUz: U har doim har bir uchrashuvda e'tiborni tortishga harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Barcha e'tiborni o'ziga tortmoq, boshqalarga imkon bermaslik.

cards.ex: I need to find a way to get my mind off work for a while.
cards.exUz: Men bir muddat ishim haqida o'ylashni to'xtatish yo'lini topishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida o'ylashni to'xtatishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: I often lose my focus when I'm working from home.
cards.exUz: Men ko'pincha uyda ishlayotganimda diqqatimni yo'qotaman.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni bir nuqtaga jamlash qobiliyatini yo'qotmoq.

cards.ex: He was so engrossed in the game that he didn't hear me come in.
cards.exUz: U o'yinga shunchalik berilib ketganki, meni kirganimni eshitmadi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirga juda qiziqib, butunlay berilib ketmoq.

cards.ex: We're dealing with a flood of information every day.
cards.exUz: Biz har kuni ma'lumotlar oqimi bilan ishlayapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p miqdordagi ma'lumot, juda ko'p ma'lumot olish.

cards.ex: Many good intentions often fall by the wayside.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yaxshi niyatlar ko'pincha unutilib ketadi.
cards.uzDef: E'tibordan chetda qolib, unutilmoq, amalga oshmay qolmoq.

cards.ex: We've had to put that project on the back burner for now.
cards.exUz: Biz hozircha bu loyihani keyinga qoldirishga majbur bo'ldik.
cards.uzDef: Hozircha muhim bo'lmaganligi sababli, keyinroqqa qoldirilgan narsa.

cards.ex: I'm tired of playing second fiddle to him.
cards.exUz: Men unga nisbatan ikkinchi darajali rol o'ynashdan charchadim.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarga nisbatan kamroq muhim rol o'ynamoq.

cards.ex: I had a moment of clarity and realized what I needed to do.
cards.exUz: Menga tiniqlik payti keldi va nima qilishim kerakligini angladim.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga tushunish yoki aniqlik paydo bo'lishi.

cards.ex: Safety always takes precedence over cost.
cards.exUz: Xavfsizlik har doim xarajatlardan ustun turadi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa narsalardan ko'ra muhimroq bo'lmoq, ustunlikka ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: His outburst was clearly a distraction tactic.
cards.exUz: Uning g'azabi aniq chalg'itish taktikasi edi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni boshqa narsaga qaratish orqali chalg'itishga urinish.
